subject: NAVIGATIONAL WARNING SERVICES IN FRANCE (NEW CALEDONIA)
text:
NAVIGATIONAL WARNING SERVICES IN FRANCE (NEW CALEDONIA)
1. AT 230001 UTC NOV 2026, THE NATIONAL COORDINATOR FOR FRANCE (NEW CALEDONIA) WILL COMMENCE NAVIGATIONAL WARNING BROADCASTS ON THE IRIDIUM SAFETYCAST SERVICE TO COASTAL WARNING AREA N IN THE ENGLISH LANGUAGE.
2. FOR FURTHER INFORMATION SEE WWW.MRCC.NC, OR CONTACT RCC AUSTRALIA, PHONE: +61262306811, EMAIL: RCCAUS@AMSA.GOV.AU.
